acceptanceCriteria: Annotation rule or stop list revised in spec and both consumers with a vector for a short code hunk; retained baselines re-emitted.
body:
Panel finding (adversary). internal/cem/verify/support.go:97-108 copies the lexical-relevance-floor-v0 stop list verbatim; it contains "return" and "value". CEM-V1-081 marks a hunk annotation when every remaining token is shorter than 3 bytes or a stop term, so a behaviour-changing hunk whose added line is `return value - 1` gets annotation:true (24/24 in the adversary maps A, U, C, E) and the flag is cleared by adding one extra word. Expected: annotation identifies comment/doc-only hunks. Actual: it misclassifies short code hunks and is trivially gamed.

Version: origin/main f8ea0758ee1b77bb45931818e47ae1a9a95d1d59 (2026-10-13). Panel evidence (scratch, not retained in-tree): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/b89960c8-2163-4353-8ea9-7b6117332c1b/scratchpad/panel/<lens>/.
title: cem citation: annotation flag classes a code hunk `return value - 1` as annotation because the stop list holds return and value
